engine: HyperAccounts step engine with optional PVACreator adapter

features.name: Independent workflow builder and row engine
features.detail: Ordered browser actions, reusable input columns, isolated sessions, a serial job queue, human checkpoints, pause/resume/cancel, persisted results, and visible success checks. Gmail-specific steps still need validation.

features.name: Selectable image CAPTCHA providers
features.detail: Manual, 2Captcha, or Anti-Captcha. Workflow defaults, action overrides, and per-row provider references. Provider integration is mock-tested; live paid solves have not been tested.

features.name: Campaign management
features.detail: Discover, create, inspect, start, stop, and remove supported campaigns through the local engine.

features.name: Gmail QR account workflow
features.detail: Add, list, monitor, and remove accounts. Requires the Gmail_Bypass_QR_Code module to be available.

features.name: SMS cost catalog
features.detail: 241 supplied rates and integer-cent estimates. Actual provider charges are not exposed by the engine.

features.name: Agent automation
features.detail: Local stdio MCP server, versioned HTTP API, and an account-registration workflow prompt.

features.name: Diagnostics and action history
features.detail: Live availability, missing configuration checks, and local action history without credential values.

features.name: Outlook and X account entry
features.detail: Campaign endpoints are available. Their account-entry schema is not documented by the published API.

features.name: Browser profiles and session management
features.detail: PVACreator documents browser profiles; its published registration API exposes no profile-management endpoints.

features.name: Account Speeder / warm-up
features.detail: No documented API endpoint is available for this module. HyperAccounts does not simulate it.

features.name: Full platform parity and fingerprint infrastructure
features.detail: Platform-specific registration templates, fingerprint infrastructure, and all original app actions have not been recreated.
